timeline.title: Foundation
timeline.description: Establishment of Dr. Salins Eye Hospital, a "Not for Profit" institution dedicated to providing quality eye care to all segments of society, with a special focus on underprivileged communities.

timeline.title: Training and Capacity Building
timeline.description: Launch of educational programs for doctors, surgeons, and vision technicians, with a unique focus on capacity building for eye hospitals across Karnataka.

timeline.title: Expansion of Services
timeline.description: Expansion of community eye care services, including opening Vision Centers in Bidar and surrounding districts, as well as in Zaheerabad, Telangana.

timeline.title: Leadership Transition
timeline.description: Dr. Sybil Salins takes over the leadership, carrying forward the legacy of her parents, Dr. and Dr. Mrs. Salins, with a vision to meet the growing demands of the community and improve eye care services.

timeline.title: Modernization
timeline.description: Major upgrades to hospital facilities, including a move towards a paperless environment and the introduction of new technology to enhance transparency and efficiency.

timeline.title: Golden Jubilee & Pandemic Response
timeline.description: Celebrating 50 years of service to the community while navigating the challenges of the pandemic, maintaining full patient care services with dedication and courage.

timeline.title: Expansion and Future Plans
timeline.description: Ongoing project to build a new, state-of-the-art hospital building, including a 6,000 sq ft operation theater complex and additional facilities to further expand eye care services.
